remote_script:
set -e
git rev-parse HEAD
ffmpeg -version | head -1
melt --version 2>&1 | head -1
readlink "/System/Library/Fonts/STHeiti Medium.ttc"
set +e
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider -rfE tests --junitxml=/root/.prbox/r312-full-20261027T105409Z-photo-dev-full-02bac1.xml
test_rc=$?
.venv/bin/python -c 'import xml.etree.ElementTree as E,json,sys
r=E.parse(sys.argv[1]).getroot(); suites=list(r.iter("testsuite")); cases=list(r.iter("testcase")); failed=[]; skipped=[]
for c in cases:
 cls=c.get("classname",""); name=c.get("name",""); parts=cls.split("."); k=next((i for i,p in enumerate(parts) if p.startswith("test_")),None)
 node=("/".join(parts[:k+1])+".py"+"".join("::"+p for p in parts[k+1:])+"::"+name) if k is not None else cls+"::"+name
 for tag,out in (("failure",failed),("error",failed),("skipped",skipped)):
  for x in c.findall(tag): out.append({"nodeid":node,"kind":tag,"message":x.get("message",""),"detail":x.text or ""})
print("R312_JUNIT_SUMMARY "+json.dumps({"counts":{k:sum(int(s.get(k,0)) for s in suites) for k in ("tests","failures","errors","skipped")},"case_count":len(cases),"failed":failed,"skipped":skipped},ensure_ascii=False))
' /root/.prbox/r312-full-20261027T105409Z-photo-dev-full-02bac1.xml
summary_rc=$?
if [ "$summary_rc" != 0 ]; then exit "$summary_rc"; fi
exit "$test_rc"
